Subject: Redwood demo — billing & procurement next steps

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time to join the demo today — really appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Demo highlights: dedicated capacity profile + predictable SLAs, billing options (hosted vs dedicated), and cost controls (batching, caching, quantization).
- Procurement/finance items we discussed you'd confirm: whether the purchase will go through Procurement (PO) or via corporate card, and whether you're interested in buying through AWS Marketplace.
- Billing requirements we need to confirm: billing address, PO numbering requirements, VAT/tax ID, and preferred invoice format.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm procurement path (PO vs card) and any internal thresholds we should be aware of?
2) Please share the billing contact, remit-to address, and any required invoice fields (PO number placement, VAT ID, tax rates).
3) If marketplace is preferred, we can share marketplace listing details and pricing cadence.

I've attached a high-level estimate for reference (Redwood_Estimate_Sept2026.pdf). I'll loop in our finance lead to help finalize invoice and net-terms details once you confirm the above.

Thanks —

On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 3:02 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the time to join the demo today — really appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 
> ...

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side: 
- Procurement: Acme's procurement prefers to issue a Purchase Order for deals over $10k. We only use corporate card for small purchases under that threshold. So this will almost certainly be PO-driven.
- Net terms: our standard is Net 30; in some cases Procurement requests Net 45 depending on vendor relationship. Please let us know if Redwood has flexibility.
- Marketplace: we prefer to buy through AWS Marketplace when possible for consolidated billing. Does Redwood appear on AWS Marketplace or do you have any plans to list?
- Invoice requirements: invoice must include our PO number, remit-to address, and our tax ID on invoices that include VAT. Our billing address:
  Acme Payments, Inc.
  Accounts Payable
  120 Market Plaza
  San Francisco, CA 94105
  United States
- VAT/Tax: We operate in multiple regions; if you need our VAT/tax ID we can provide the relevant entity info depending on which billing entity is used.

Happy to set up a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Sam Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Payments
sam.nguyen@acmepayments.com

Thanks Sam — that's very helpful. A few quick notes / confirmations from our side: 

- We can absolutely accept a PO and include the PO number on the invoice.
- Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace (we'll share the listing link) — if you prefer marketplace procurement we can walk through that cadence.
- We can produce invoices that include PO number, VAT/Tax ID fields, and the remit-to address exactly as you provided.

Could you please confirm the following so our billing ops team can generate the correct paperwork?
1) Full legal entity and VAT/tax ID you want on the invoice (if applicable).
2) Who should receive the invoice PDF (email) and purchase-order acknowledgements.
3) Whether Procurement needs a vendor setup form or W-9 (if US entity).

I've attached our standard invoice template for reference (Redwood_Invoice_Template.docx). I've looped in Vivek from Finance to confirm net-terms and payment methods.

If it's easier, we can schedule a 20-minute sync with procurement & finance to finalize the PO and invoice fields.

Thanks —

Hi Sam / Marissa —

I'm Vivek in Finance Ops — thanks for the details, Sam. Quick summary from finance: 

- Standard net-terms: Net 30 upon invoice. We can consider Net 45 for enterprise deals with approved credit; that requires a credit application and CS sign-off.
- Accepted payment methods: ACH, wire transfer, and corporate card (card incurs processing fee; if paying by card please confirm PO still for your records).
- Invoice requirements: we will include PO number on invoice header, your remit-to address, and an explicit VAT/Tax ID field if provided.
- Remit-to & billing address (as provided):
  Acme Payments, Inc.
  Accounts Payable
  120 Market Plaza
  San Francisco, CA 94105
  United States

Please send over the exact legal entity name and VAT ID to include on the invoice. Also send the PO when it's ready — we'll return an invoice PDF with your PO number and our vendor info. If you prefer the AWS Marketplace route, invoices will flow through marketplace billing (we can share the vendor listing and documentation).

I'm attaching a blank PO template you can use if helpful (PO_Template_Acme.pdf). Happy to join a short call to walk through procurement details if that's useful.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
